research_insights.selection_rationale: Continuous-review (r,Q) is appropriate for this material given its intermittent but high-value demand pattern, moderate lead time variability, and the need for a precise reorder trigger. The EOQ formula provides the economically optimal order quantity under holding and ordering cost trade-offs, and the reorder point incorporates safety stock calibrated to 95% service level via the lead-time demand standard deviation.
